title: 作为家具的著名地标
prompt: The [LANDMARK - Statue of Liberty/Eiffel Tower/Big Ben] perfectly carved and functional as a [FURNITURE_PIECE - lamp/bookshelf/coffee table], living room setting, normal scale furniture, photorealistic detail.
description: Nano Banana Pro 将自由女神像等著名地标转化为功能家具，如台灯或书架，在客厅中呈现逼真细节，适合室内摄影与雕塑创作。Nano Banana Pro 同样以写实风格重塑埃菲尔铁塔等元素，为车辆主题项目注入艺术活力，打造创意生活空间。
